# Event catalog

The standard event objects (ADR-0022 §5). Connectors map provider webhooks into them; waits (`events:`), steering (`steer:`), stop matchers and bindings (`on:`) match them by `type`. A custom event matches by its declared `name`. Format reference: [format.md](format.md).

## Envelope

Every event has these fields next to `type` and the payload fields.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Dedupe id assigned by the source. |
| `repo` | string |  | `owner/repo` the event is about. |
| `actor` | Actor |  |  |
| `subject` | SubjectRef |  | The GitHub object the event is about, used for routing. |
| `at` | string |  | RFC 3339 time the event happened. The interpreter's only clock. |

Two more types exist only inside the engine and can be waited on: `timer` (a wait's `timer` fired; `event.timer_id`) and `fact` (a refreshed fact; `event.fact`, `event.value`).

## Types

### `comment`

A comment on an issue or pull request.

`command`/`args` are parsed from the first line (`/word a b`, optionally after a leading `@bot` mention).

Schema: [`schemas/events/comment.json`](schemas/events/comment.json) (`Comment`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | string | yes |  |
| `command` | string |  |  |
| `args` | list of string |  |  |
| `url` | string |  |  |
